name: Wayfront
description:
Wayfront is agency client portal software for digital agencies selling repeatable productized services. Each purchase starts the right workflow, while repeat orders, renewals, referrals, prepaid packages, and reseller sales create more value from the client relationship.

Connect Wayfront to Claude and work with your agency’s current client and delivery data. Analyze conversations, catch follow-ups, find the right next service to offer, and update CRM records while the context is still fresh.

You can also create and adjust services and forms through chat. Tighten intake, fix clunky handoffs, and keep work moving from purchase to delivery.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wayfront to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wayfront to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wayfront.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wayfront MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wayfront lists 48 MCP tools, including automation-read, automation-write, client-custom-field-read, client-custom-field-write, client-read, client-write, coupon-read, coupon-write, form-folder-read, form-folder-write, form-read, and form-write.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wayfront?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wayfront in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Wayfront requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wayfront is developed by Wayfront. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
